page0.text:
She easily cuts at the man in red.
Saber raises her arm, ready to—
But before she's able to take his head, incredibly powerful magecraft causes him to vanish.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page0:1

page1.text:
Saber doesn't stop.
She dashes right at the person standing behind the man in red...
...and effortlessly negates the potent magecraft they'd unleashed.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page1:1

page2.text:
"Wha...!?"
I knew she was strong, but this is just unreal.
That was a sort of intervention magecraft way beyond anything I'm capable of.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page2:1

page3.text:
My old man might have been able to cast something with a bit of weight to it, but I'm not sure even a first-rate mage could just cast something so powerful at the drop of a hat like that.
Even so, Saber nullifies the magecraft as if it were nothing.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page3:1

page4.text:
The enemy must be a mage, which means this match's outcome is decided.
The mage's attack doesn't work on Saber, and Saber drives at them mercilessly.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page4:1

page5.text:
The mage falls backward with a thud.
The enemy miraculously dodges Saber's attack, but they can't move anymore.
Saber corners the enemy, and levels her invisible sword at them.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page5:1

page6.text:
...
My mind freezes.
Maybe it's a momentary glimmer of moonlight,
but I see then that Saber is attacking a human.
I can't tell who it is specifically, but the image of Saber killing someone, their blood staining her hands suddenly fills my mind.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page6:1

page7.text:
...
Saber moves in.
She's going to slit open their throat with that invisible sword.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page7:1

page8.text:
"SABER, STOP!"
I scream as loud as I can.
Her blade stops cold.
It's probably best for my sanity that I can't see her sword.
But the tip of that invisible sword isn't wet with her opponent's blood just yet.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page8:1

page9.text:
"Stop. I beg you, Saber."
I glare at her as I speak.
If I'm going to stop her, I need to prepare myself to give everything I've got to do so.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page9:1

page10.text:
"Why are you stopping me, Shirou? She is Archer's Master. I must put an end to her here and now."
No, Saber has absolutely no intention of stopping.
She only stopped because I told her to, but she still holds her sword at the ready.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page10:1

page11.text: "I-I'm telling you, wait. You keep calling me Master, but I still don't understand what's going on. If you're going to address me that way, then wouldn't it be right to explain yourself first!?"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page11:1

page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page12:1

page13.text:
Saber doesn't answer.
She just stands there, staring at me.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page13:1

page14.text: "We're going about this wrong, Saber. I don't even know who you are. But I'll listen if you tell me, so please don't do this."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page14:1

page15.text:
"..."
Saber is silent.
She still holds her sword to her opponent, and stares at me, her lips downturned in dissatisfaction.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page15:1

page16.text:
"What do you mean, 'don't do this'?
Is this an expression of your idealistic belief that people should not needlessly harm another?"
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page16:1

page17.text:
"Eh...?"
Don't needlessly harm another?
Well yeah, it's better to avoid conflict as much as possible, but I'm not so softhearted as to feel sorry for someone who's attacking me.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page17:1

page18.text: "So you are saying that nobody should take the life of another, even should they be an enemy, correct? I will not obey such an order. One's enemies must be defeated. If you still wish to stop me, then use your Command Spell to order me."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page18:1

page19.text:
"Huh? I'm talking about you. A girl shouldn't go swinging swords around, especially if she's already hurt.
...Oh wait. I don't even know if that's a sword to begin with. Uh, anyway...you shouldn't be doing this!"
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page19:1

page20.text:
...
In that moment, Saber's mouth falls open in stunned silence.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page20:1

page21.text:
I don't know how much time passes with her just standing there like that.
"So, I'm wondering when Saber here is going to lower her sword."
The person who'd fallen to the ground speaks up out of nowhere.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page21:1

page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page22:1

page23.text:
"Give it up. I would never lower my sword in the face of an enemy."
"Even though your Master is telling you to?
Is that so? I didn't know Servants, especially Sabers, defied their Masters."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page23:1

page24.text:
...
Saber grits her teeth...
...but she lowers her sword, loosening her grip a bit.
She must have put her sword away or something, because she seems suddenly much less hostile.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page24:1

page25.text:
"Okay. So I can stand up now, right?"
Whoever it was that's been on the ground finally stands.
They act brazen, as they pat the dirt from their bottom.
...Wait a minute.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page25:1

page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page26:1

page27.text:
"Y-you're Tohsaka!?"
"Yes. Good evening, Emiya."
Rin Tohsaka replies with the biggest smile on her face.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page27:1

page28.text:
"Ah...um..."
This is unbelievable.
I don't know what to think anymore. The way she greets me so casually makes me question whether everything that happened was even real.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page28:1

page29.text:
"Uh...um, well...so you were the one who cast that magecraft earlier, which makes you..."
"A mage. Well, we're pretty much the same, so I guess there's no sense hiding it anymore."
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page29:1

page30.text:
"Guh."
Hearing her be so blunt about it makes me seem like the idiot here.
"Anyway, let's talk inside. I bet you have no clue what's going on, right, Emiya?"
As she says that, she walks towards the entrance to my house.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page30:1

page31.text:
"Eh? Wait, Tohsaka! What the hell are you thinking?"
At that moment...
...when Tohsaka turns around, her smile has changed into something completely different.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page31:1

page32.text:
"Don't be silly. I'm thinking about a lot of things. And that's why I'm offering to talk.
Emiya, I know you're surprised by all the things that just happened, but sometimes you just have to accept certain things or you'll wind up dead. This, by the way, is one of those times."
She glares at me, and I can see actual animosity in her eyes.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page32:1

page33.text:
"..."
"I'm glad you understand. Now, let's get inside."
Tohsaka walks through the gate.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page33:1

page34.text:
"She seems really pissed."
Well, I don't blame her.
Just a moment ago, she had a sword pointed at her, and she was about to die.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page34:1

page35.text:
"But still..."
Maybe it's my imagination, but I think the Tohsaka at school and the one I see right now are completely different people.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page35:1

page36.text:
And this is just weird as hell.
Rin Tohsaka, the most popular girl in school...the girl I admire...is walking in front of me.
While a blonde girl named Saber, who calls herself a Servant, is silently following behind me.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page36:1

page37.text:
"..."
Hm.
The hallway feels like it's in a different dimension.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page37:1

page38.text:
But I can't stay a coward forever.
I may still be in training, but I'm still a mage.
Tohsaka, who is apparently a fellow mage, is as bold as brass, so I have to hold my ground too or else I'll look stupid.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page38:1

page39.text:
Though, I can't really think of anything all that significant here.
Like...Saber, still following me.
She keeps calling me Master, and we've formed some sort of contract...which probably makes her a kind of familiar.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page39:1

page40.text:
I've heard a familiar is an assistant mages use.
Most mages transfer a part of their own body into something else, then use it as their double.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page40:1

page41.text:
But typically they're small animals.
Things like cats and dogs are just easier to control.
Some mages do use humans, but to do that, they need an incredible amount of magical energy to constantly feed into the human to control them.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page41:1

page42.text:
Doing that would require a mage to use over half of their own magical energy just to sustain the familiar though.
So it's not exactly efficient.
Familiars are supposed to be tools to help mages.
Which is why they usually use small animals, who can be controlled with minimal effort, and so aren't any burden.
...At least that's what I was taught.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page42:1

page43.text:
"Hm? Is something the matter, Shirou?"
"Uh, no. Nothing."
Saber obviously looks human. And she is clearly superior to her Master, that is, me.
I don't have enough magical energy to restrain someone, let alone the Magic Circuits to control familiars in the first place.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page43:1

page44.text:
"..."
Which means Saber is nothing like a familiar.
She called herself a Servant.
I don't know what she is, but that man named Lancer, and the man in red Tohsaka has in tow are probably all the same.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page44:1

page45.text:
Which means Tohsaka can also be called a Master.
I've already seen enough of her magecraft skills.
I'm less than a fledgling, but based on what I've seen, Tohsaka is probably worth three mages...though there's really not much sense comparing any mage to someone like me, who can only do Strengthening.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page45:1

page46.text:
What's clear is that Rin Tohsaka is an exceptional mage.
In spiritually strong lands, there are mage family lines which oversee a given area.
The Emiya family came during Kiritsugu's generation, so our family is essentially outsiders.
That's why I didn't know Tohsaka came from a family of mages, and I don't think Tohsaka knew I came from one either.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page46:1

page47.text:
...There are several mages in this town I don't know about.
If that Lancer guy is another mage's familiar too, that means I've gotten myself in the middle of some sort of fight between mages.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page47:1

page48.text:
"Wow. This place is roomier than expected. And the Japanese style of this room is unique.
Oh, Emiya, is this the sitting room?"
"..."
I should really just stop thinking for now.
Now's the time to pay attention to what Tohsaka has to say.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page48:1

page49.text:
I turn on the lights.
It's already past one in the morning.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page49:1

page50.text:
"Whoa, it's so cold here! Hey, the windows are all broken!"
"That's not my fault. That Lancer guy attacked me. I didn't really have time to worry about windows."
"I see. So you were fighting that guy all by yourself until you summoned Saber?"
"I'd say I was more of a punching bag than an opponent, really."
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page50:1

page51.text:
"Huh. So you don't try to act all tough. I see. So you really are exactly as I thought."
I don't know what's so amusing to her, but Tohsaka walks over to the broken window.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page51:1

page52.text:
"Hm?"
Tohsaka picks up a broken piece of glass. She stares at it for a second...
"Minuten vor Schweißen."
She cuts her finger tip and lets a single drop of blood fall onto the window.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page52:1

page53.text:
"Gh—!?"
What kind of magecraft is that?
The shattered window begins to reassemble itself, returning to its original, undamaged state in mere seconds.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page53:1

page54.text:
"Tohsaka, what did you just do—"
"Just a little demonstration. It's not really a fit thank you for saving me back there, but I figure I should at least be gracious."
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page54:1

page55.text:
"Well, I'm sure you would have fixed it without my help, since doing it this way is just a waste of magical energy. I know you could've just replaced the windows, but I'd rather not talk in the cold."
She says all of this like it's a normal thing.
Her skills are just...beyond my comprehension.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page55:1

page56.text: "That's amazing, Tohsaka. I can't do anything like that, so I appreciate you fixing it."
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page56:1

page57.text:
"What? You can't do this? No, that can't be right.
Handling glass is one of the most basic skills. Fixing broken glass is like an entrance exam for any school."
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page57:1

page58.text:
"Is it, now? I only know what my old man taught me, so I don't really know what you'd consider the basics."
"Huh!?"
Tohsaka stops abruptly.
Crap. Sounds like I said something I shouldn't have.
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page58:1

page59.text:
"Wait a minute. Are you telling me you're not even a full-fledged mage with his own workshop to manage?"
"Huh? I don't have a workshop."
Well actually I have the shed I use for training, but I think calling that a workshop would just make Tohsaka angrier.
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page59:1

page60.text:
"Wait, don't tell me. Do you not know how to handle the Five Great Elements, or make a Magical Path?"
I just nod.
"..."
Whoa, that's terrifying.
Beautiful as she is, she gets...intense when she goes quiet.
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page60:1

page61.text:
"So you're what? A complete amateur?"
"Not exactly, no. I can at least do some Strengthening magecraft."
"Strengthen... Kind of a useless skill if you ask me. So you don't know anything else?"
Tohsaka just stares at me.
"Honestly? Probably not."
Her stare is so intense, I can't help but be vague in my answer."
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page61:1

page62.text:
"I just don't get how the likes of him wound up summoning Saber."
She sighs, disappointed.
"Hmph."
I don't much care for that.
It's not like I've been playing around here.
Sure, I'm not a full-fledged mage, but that's not the issue here.
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page62:1

page63.text:
"Fine. What's done is done, so there's no sense complaining now. More importantly, I owe you and need to pay you back."
Tohsaka takes a breath.
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page63:1

page64.text:
"So let's begin.
Let me start by asking: Do you really not know anything about the position you're in here?"
...
I nod.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page64:1

page65.text:
"I knew it. It was pretty obvious, but I just wanted to check. It would be a waste of time if I explain all of this to someone who knew everything—like a bit of extra mental flab.
"Hm?"
That was a...really weird way to put that, but I feel like if I get smart with her, she'll smack me.
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page65:1

page66.text:
"Let me get straight to the point. Emiya, you've been selected as a Master.
You see those sacred marks on your hand? They vary from person to person, but they're typically on the back of your hand or arm, and there should be three strokes of Command Spells engraved there. They're the mark that proves you are a Master."
"Back of my hand... Oh, you mean this."
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page66:1

page67.text: "Right. Take good care of it, since those are spells that control Servants. They're called Command Spells, and as long as you have them, you can give orders to your Servant."
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page67:1

page68.text:
"What do you mean, as long as I have them?"
"Command Spells are absolute orders. You might have already figured out that Servants have free will, but those engravings in your hand overrule their will and force them to obey."
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page68:1

page69.text:
"There's no need to chant any kind of incantation. They activate when you think about using them.
But each time you use one, you'll lose a stroke. So try to keep yourself to only using two.
Anyway, just be careful. I'm pretty sure you'll die the moment you run of Command Spells."
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page69:1

page70.text:
"Eh? I'm going to die...?"
"Yah-huh. Masters defeating Masters is pretty much how a Holy Grail War goes. And the Master who defeats the other six is rewarded with the Holy Grail."
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page70:1

page71.text:
"Wh...at?"
H-hold on a second.
I don't understand what the hell Tohsaka's saying.
Masters defeating Masters?
And then they're granted the Holy Grail... And is the Holy Grail THE Holy Grail!?
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page71:1

page72.text:
"Still don't get it? Look, you've basically been dragged into a game.
It's called the Holy Grail War, and it's a battle between seven Masters. It's a fight between mages that won't end until only one Master remains.
Tohsaka talks about this like it's the most normal thing in the world.
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page72:1

page73.text:
...
Everything she says swirls around in my head.
I was chosen as a Master.
Tohsaka claims to be a Master.
Familiars called Servants.
And...
The Holy Grail War, a battle to the death between seven mages.
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page73:1

page74.text:
"Okay, wait. What the hell are you talking about?"
"I understand your confusion, but I'm only telling you the truth here.
And I'm sure you understand deep down that you're in no position to run away from all this, since you've nearly been killed by a Servant not once, but twice."
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page74:1

page75.text:
...
That...
True, that Lancer guy did nearly kill me.
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page75:1

page76.text:
"Oh, right. You weren't almost killed. You were killed. I'm impressed you managed to come back from that."
...
Tohsaka's comment is the final nail in the coffin.
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page76:1

page77.text:
She's absolutely right.
That guy killed me. I died.
There was no chance for me to talk him out of it, nor convince him otherwise, and I was only there to die.
That's why...
Me backing out of this incomprehensible death match doesn't mean the others will do the same.
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page77:1

page78.text:
...
"Get it? Okay, I'm going to tell you a bit more.
I don't know why there's a Holy Grail War in the first place.
But what I do know is that every few decades, seven Masters are selected and they are given Servants."
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page78:1

page79.text:
"I'm also one of the chosen Masters. That's why I've formed a contract with a Servant, and you formed one with Saber.
Think of a Servant as a familiar given to you by the Holy Grail to use to win the Holy Grail War.
And as Masters, we need to work with our Servants to get rid of the other Masters."
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page79:1

page80.text:
"..."
Tohsaka explains things matter-of-factly, but it feels totally unreal to me.
But one thing she mentioned raises a question.
page80.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page80:1

page81.text:
"Wait. You say Saber is a familiar, but I don't think she is.
Familiars are usually cats or birds. Sure, there are some folks who use ghosts, but Saber has a physical body. Plus, she doesn't look like a familiar to me."
page81.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page81:1

page82.text:
I glance over at Saber.
She's been quiet the whole time.
Saber looks completely human to me.
I don't know who she is, but she looks to be a girl about the same age as me.
page82.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page82:1

page83.text:
"A familiar... Well, Servants might be in that category but they're on a different level. See, that girl over there is a Ghost Liner, considered to be one of the strongest of all familiars."
"A Ghost Liner? So does that means she really is a ghost?"
page83.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page83:1

page84.text:
The spirit of a human...someone who died long ago.
The residual thoughts of a person of exceptional ability, who remains in this world even after their death.
But that doesn't make sense.
Ghosts don't possess a physical body. Ghosts can only hurt other ghosts.
So how could I, who possesses a body, be killed by a spirit?
page84.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page84:1

page85.text:
"A ghost... Well, they are similar, but Saber will kill you if you keep thinking like that.
Servants are incarnated heroes of the past... So they're a kind of spirit well beyond humans."
"Huh? Incarnated heroes of the past?"
"That's right. Whether they're from history or the modern world, these spirits of dead, legendary heroes are summoned and materialize here."
page85.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page85:1

page86.text:
"Well, the role of the Master is just to summon them, and the Holy Grail is what helps with the materialization.
There's no way a mere mage could give spirits form, so we need to rely on a powerful artifact."
page86.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page86:1

page87.text:
"Wait a minute. Are you saying that a hero from the past is... WHAT!?"
I look at Saber.
So she's a hero of the past too!?
Well sure...nobody in the modern era would dress like her. But still...
page87.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page87:1

page88.text:
"But that's impossible. I've never heard of magecraft like that."
"Of course not. This isn't magecraft. Just think of this as a phenomenon brought by the Holy Grail. Otherwise there's no way a soul could be recreated and actualized."
"A recreation of a soul? Does that mean these Servants are different than phantoms?"
page88.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page88:1

page89.text:
"Nope. Once something—whether that be humans, an animal, or even machinery—achieves something great, they are removed from the cycle of reincarnation and sublimated into something with a higher rank. Didn't you even learn about that?
That's what Heroic Spirits are.
Put another way, they're kind of like pseudo-gods who are all worshiped in some way or another."
page89.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page89:1

page90.text:
"Seances, mediums, and other common magecraft that deals with spirits just borrows some of the spirit's powers to perform miracles.
But Servants are Heroic Spirits themselves, used as familiars.
That's why they typically accompany you in spirit form, but materialize when it's time to fight if they're needed."
page90.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page90:1

page91.text:
"Hm. So they can switch between spirit form and being corporeal.
I don't see your Servant right now, so does that mean he's in spirit form right now?"
"No. He's healing his wound in my compound's summoning circle right now.
Remember, Saber wounded him earlier. If I'd made him withdraw even a heartbeat later, that blow would have annihilated him."
page91.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page91:1

page92.text:
"Listen. Only Servants in spirit form can defeat other Servants in spirit form. We can attack them when they're materialized, so we might be able to defeat them like that.
But you've noticed all the Servants are monstrously strong, right? That's why we should leave the monsters to deal with the monsters while Masters hang back and serve as support."
page92.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page92:1

page93.text:
"...Gr."
Tohsaka's explanation ticks me off.
I don't know what the other Servants are like, but calling Servants monsters doesn't feel like a fair description of Saber.
page93.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page93:1

page94.text:
"Anyway, humans who become Masters use their summoned Servant to defeat the other Masters.
Did you at least get that much?"
page94.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page94:1

page95.text:
"In theory, yeah. But I'm still not convinced.
First of all, what kind of sick mind thought to do this in the first place?"
page95.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page95:1

page96.text:
"That I don't know, nor could I answer even if I did. That sort of question should go to the person overseeing the Holy Grail War.
The only thing I can tell you is that you really don't have any choice but to fight, and to use your Servant well, because they're powerful."
page96.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page96:1

page97.text: As Tohsaka says that, she turns to Saber.
page97.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page97:1

page98.text: "Saber, after to talking to Emiya, it looks like you're not in your complete form...you're incomplete since you were summoned by an apprentice mage who has no idea what it means to be a Master.
page98.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page98:1

page99.text:
"Yes, you are correct that I am not in my complete form.
Shirou does not have enough magical energy to fully materialize me, which means reverting to spirit form and replenishing magical energy are difficult."
page99.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page99:1

page100.text: "I'm surprised. Your situation's worse than I expected, and I didn't think you'd be so honest with me about it. I was actually just kind of subtly trying to find out your weakness."
page100.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page100:1

page101.text:
"I am reluctant to reveal my weakness to an enemy, but I also do not think I can deceive you. There's no point in hiding our situation from you.
As such, we are better off if you know our circumstances, and give Shirou a better understanding of the situation."
page101.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page101:1

page102.text: "Exactly. How very insightful of you. Argh! I still can't believe it! If only I was Saber's Master, I would have as good as won this thing!"
page102.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page102:1

page103.text:
"Tohsaka, are you saying I'm not fit to be her Master?"
"Obviously not, you freaking sham!"
Whoa. Anyone with a heart might have softened that blow a bit.
page103.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page103:1

page104.text:
"What? Do you have more questions?"
But she doesn't realize how hurtful her words are.
My image of her as the perfect honor student at school slowly crumbles.
Issei sure was right about her... She's fiendishly relentless.
page104.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page104:1

page105.text:
"Okay, now that we're at a good spot, let's get going."
Tohsaka announces this curtly.
But it's...kinda weird.
page105.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page105:1

page106.text:
"What? Go? Where?"
"I told you. We're going to see the guy who knows all about the game...the Holy Grail War you got roped into. You want to know why it happens, right?"
page106.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page106:1

page107.text:
"Yeah, of course. But where are we going? It's already late, and if it's too far—"
"It's fine. He's just in the next town over, and we can get back home before dawn. Plus, tomorrow's Sunday, so it doesn't matter if we're up late."
page107.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page107:1

page108.text:
"Uh, that's not the issue here."
So much has happened today, and I'm utterly exhausted. I just want to rest and organize my thoughts.
page108.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page108:1

page109.text:
"What, you don't want to go? Fine by me, but what about you, Saber?"
For some reason Tohsaka's asking for Saber's opinion.
"Wait. Saber's got nothing to do with this. Don't push her."
page109.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page109:1

page110.text:
"Oh, already acting like a Master, are we? You don't like me talking to Saber?"
"Th-that's not it! It's just that if everything you said about this whole thing is true, then that would mean Saber's a hero from the past. That means she wouldn't know anything about the modern era.
That's why—"
page110.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page110:1

page111.text:
"Shirou. You are incorrect. Servants can adapt to any time as long as they are summoned in a human world. So I am very aware of this age."
"Eh? You are? Really?"
"Of course This is not the first time I have been summoned to this age."
page111.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page111:1

page112.text:
"Wha..."
"Seriously? What are the odds?"
Oh hey, Tohsaka's surprised too.
That must mean what Saber said is at least somewhat unusual.
page112.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page112:1

page113.text:
"Shirou, I agree with her. You lack knowledge as Master. As your contracted Servant, I would prefer that you be stronger."
Saber silently stares at me.
The look on her face tells me she's saying this for my sake, not for her own safety.
page113.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page113:1

page114.text:
"Fine. Guess I have to go, don't I?
So where is this place, Tohsaka? We can still...get back here from there, right?"
"Of course we can. Our destination is Kotomine Church, just in the next town. That's where the sham priest—the one who oversees this whole battle—lives."
page114.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page114:1

page115.text:
Tohsaka flashes a mischievous grin.
It's the look of someone who's enjoying teasing me since I have no clue what's going on.
"..."
At least that's what I think.
I'm starting to believe Tohsaka has a really nasty side.
page115.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-17:page115:1
